findings.claim: Customer signed proof accepted missing iat or future iat hidden by nbf and therefore beyond documented15-minute issuance validity.

limitations_and_open_behavior: No genuine live customer journeys available: prior live-summary customer count0 and no customer operation traffic in last7days. This absence is tenant data/configuration, not an OPS API defect.

Prior ops-live-catalog tables and selected functions are corroboration only; function listing is selective and omits many customer RPCs, so missing name there is not evidence of undeployed dependency. Source migrations and generated signatures establish code dependency names; root live dependency gate owns actual production existence.
Support quotas are pre-write exact counts, not serialized reservations. Distinct concurrent requests can race; no production concurrency test executed, so hard cap guarantee remains unverified.

Support closure checks occur before separate message/attachment insert, not a locked native transaction; concurrent close-versus-new-write atomicity is unverified. Completed replay-after-close is tested and deliberately allowed.
PDF content check is magic-byte/name regex+EOF check, not full PDF parsing/antivirus. Compressed PDF object-stream active-content rejection is unverified.

Tenant customer sync is multi-resource sequential and can partially commit; legal/POA evidence checks are tenant-bounded; function event dedupe key is customer/event/ref based, not payload-specific, so repeated different document sync events may collapse.
Invoice detail publicly exposes quantity/unit_price and currency/amounts but no per-line unit; exact line DTO uses broad schema and deserves explicit documentation.
